ai_summary: Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited (ACGL) has set October 28, 2026, as the record date for its previously announced buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. This procedural announcement is a key step for shareholders to determine their eligibility to participate in the buyback, which typically aims to return capital to shareholders and can enhance earnings per share by reducing outstanding shares. There are no immediate red flags, as a buyback often signals management's confidence in the company's valuation or its capital allocation strategy.
